Avro is derived from the physical Parquet schema. The independent embedded Arrow declaration, custom metadata and schema/data correspondence remain in source; no field correspondence or semantic equivalence is inferred.
Embedded Arrow /fields/0 ("events"): LargeList width/layout are not enforced by an Avro array.
Embedded Arrow /fields/1 ("elapsed"): duration unit MICROSECOND is not a physical integer or Avro duration semantic; any row binding must preserve the unit explicitly.
Embedded Arrow /fields/2 ("created"): named timezone "America/New_York" is not retained by Avro instant timestamps.
